tools.name: SwitchScene
tools.description: Switches the current OBS program scene.

scene.description: Name of the scene to switch to.

tools.name: StartStream
tools.description: Starts the OBS stream.

tools.name: StopStream
tools.description: Stops the OBS stream.

tools.name: StartRecording
tools.description: Starts the OBS recording.

tools.name: StopRecording
tools.description: Stops the OBS recording.

tools.name: SetSourceVisibility
tools.description: Sets the visibility of a source in a specific scene.

scene.description: Name of the scene containing the source.

visible.description: True to make visible, false to hide.

tools.name: GetSceneList
tools.description: Gets the list of available OBS scenes.

tools.name: SetTextContent
tools.description: Sets the text content of a text source.

text.description: The new text content to set.

tools.name: SetAudioMute
tools.description: Mutes or unmutes an audio source.

mute.description: True to mute, false to unmute.

tools.name: SetAudioVolume
tools.description: Sets the volume of an audio source.

tools.name: SetSourcePosition
tools.description: Sets the position of a source in a scene.

scene.description: Name of the scene containing the source.

tools.name: SetSourceScale
tools.description: Sets the scale of a source in a scene.

scene.description: Name of the scene containing the source.

tools.name: TakeSourceScreenshot
tools.description: Takes a screenshot of the specified source.

source.description: Name of the source to capture.

filePath.description: File path where the screenshot should be saved (optional).

width.description: Optional width to resize the screenshot to.

height.description: Optional height to resize the screenshot to.

compressionQuality.description: Optional compression quality. For PNG (default format): 0-9 (OBS default is 4). For JPEG: 0-100 (OBS default is typically around 85-90). For WebP: 0-100. Use -1 for OBS default for the chosen format.

tools.name: SetTransitionSettings
tools.description: Sets the current scene transition type and duration. 用途: シーン切り替え時のエフェクトをカスタマイズ

transitionName.description: Name of the transition to set (e.g., 'Fade', 'Cut', 'Slide').

transitionDuration.description: Duration of the transition in milliseconds.

tools.name: TriggerStudioModeTransition
tools.description: Triggers the transition from Preview to Program in Studio Mode. 用途: シーンの準備と切り替えをスムーズに行う

tools.name: PlayPauseMedia
tools.description: Controls playback of a media source (play, pause, stop, restart). 用途: 動画クリップやオーディオの再生制御

tools.name: SetMediaTime
tools.description: Sets the current playback time of a media source. 用途: 特定シーンへのジャンプ、リプレイの開始位置設定

tools.name: SaveReplayBuffer
tools.description: Saves the content of the replay buffer. 用途: ゲームのハイライト瞬間を即座に保存

tools.name: SaveReplayBufferAndAdd
tools.description: Saves the replay buffer and adds it as a media source to a scene. 用途: リプレイをすぐにシーンに表示

sceneName.description: Name of the scene to add the replay to.

sourceName.description: Name for the new media source.

replayFolder.description: Path to the folder where replay files are saved (optional).

tools.name: CreateSource
tools.description: Creates a new source in a specified scene. 用途: リプレイ映像用の新しいメディアソースを生成

sceneName.description: Name of the scene to add the source to.

setVisible.description: Whether the source should be visible after creation (default: true).

tools.name: SetShaderFilter
tools.description: Sets parameters for a shader filter on a source. 用途: シェーダーエフェクトをリアルタイムで変更する

sourceName.description: Name of the source with the shader filter.

tools.name: SetLutFilter
tools.description: Sets parameters for a LUT filter on a source. 用途: LUTフィルターの適用量やファイルパスをリアルタイムで変更する

sourceName.description: Name of the source with the LUT filter.

tools.name: GetSceneItemList
tools.description: Gets the list of scene items (sources) in a specified scene.

sceneName.description: Name of the scene to get items from.
